--- title: "Week 15 - Update" author: "Victoria Sjalim" date: "2026-11-26" format: html execute: freeze: auto --- # Overview - Have a good grill me sessions for CDS-IS external validations with Claude - Merge pull with Dimas's pipeline (notes for Dimas please keep me updated with your changes) - Made new github repo for eris validations `https://github.com/Victoriasja18/eris-validation` How to navigate these repo: # IS–CDS relation validation Scores from [eris-validation](https://github.com/Victoriasja18/eris-validation): for each IS, did eris report the right CDS **upstream** and **downstream**, at the right **distance**, with the right **effect** (disrupted)? Truth: `ec958_IS_cds_relations.tsv` (117 relations; 94 on the chromosome for the simulated GFA). eris: Dimas's main (`e4c6dbd`), collapse mode, `--hops 3`, `min_coverage 0.30`. ```bash cd ../../eris-validation uv run snakemake --cores 4 ``` ::: {#776c74a8 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pandas as pd RESULTS = "../result/eris_validation" ASSEMBLIES = {"complete": "Complete genome (FASTA)", "simulated": "Simulated GFA", "real": "Real-reads GFA"} metrics = pd.read_csv(f"{RESULTS}/metrics.tsv", sep="\t") details = pd.read_csv(f"{RESULTS}/details.tsv", sep="\t") for table in (metrics, details): table["assembly"] = table["assembly_type"].map(ASSEMBLIES) ``` ::: ## Precision, recall and F1 Side: recall is over the truth relations; precision is over eris's nearest flank on each side (per graph branch). A flank on the wrong side counts as a miss on its true side and a false call on the side reported. Distance: per band (overlapping, near 0–150 bp, far), over relations found on their side. Effect: disrupted only; eris `TRUNCATED` counts as disrupted. Recall = TP / (TP + FN) over the truth relations. Precision = TP_calls / (TP_calls + FP) over eris's calls; for side and effect these are eris's nearest flanks, so TP_calls can be lower than TP (one collapsed IS locus can find several truth relations, e.g. the flanks of several copies, but has only one nearest flank per side per branch). ::: {#d1be6686 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} (metrics.drop(columns=["genome", "assembly_type"]) .set_index(["assembly", "dimension", "class"]) .style.format("{:.2f}", subset=["precision", "recall", "f1"], na_rep="–")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
